verdict.rationale: Recurly publishes a developer API hub at recurly.com/developers/api with official client libraries for Ruby, Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, PHP and Go, plus native mobile SDKs. Its docs say capabilities such as real-time entitlement checks run through the Recurly API, and webhooks deliver real-time subscription events. The Compass MCP server also exposes Recurly's tools and APIs to AI agents. Missing for 10: evidence of the API reference contents themselves (endpoint coverage, authentication, versioning, rate limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
